title: pentanisia prunelloides subsp. latifolia
intro: Pentanisia prunelloides subsp. latifolia, commonly known as Mountain Geranium, is a species of flowering plant in the family Scrophulariaceae. The health benefits of Mountain Geranium include its use as an anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial agent, which can aid in treating various skin conditions and wounds. The therapeutic actions of this plant include its ability to stimulate blood circulation and relieve pain due to its analgesic and vasodilatory properties. The bioactive constituents of Mountain Geranium include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
